Description: "Normalize items loaded when settling a live order from the order tracker view to prevent NaN calculations and missing names."
ReplacementContent:
"                                                 setSelectedTable(activeOrderToView.original);
                                                 setCart(
                                                   (Array.isArray(activeOrderToView.items) ? activeOrderToView.items : []).map(i => ({
                                                     id: i.id,
                                                     product_name: i.product_name || i.name || 'Item',
                                                     name: i.name || i.product_name || 'Item',
                                                     quantity: parseInt(i.quantity || i.qty || 1, 10),
                                                     qty: parseInt(i.qty || i.quantity || 1, 10),
                                                     price: parseFloat(i.price) || 0,
                                                     modifiers: i.modifiers || [],
                                                     kot_category: i.kot_category || 'Main Kitchen'
                                                   }))
                                                 );"
toolSummary: "Edit App.jsx for live order items normalization"
